assessment.nobel_worthiness: Predicting and then observing the quantum spin Hall state and the Z2 topological insulator opened a whole class of materials with protected edge and surface states. The idea is original, the experimental confirmation is clear, and the field's reach is broad, extending from materials to quantum devices.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele supplied the decisive theory (Z2 classification, quantum spin Hall proposal for graphene). Molenkamp's group gave the first experimental demonstration in HgTe quantum wells, following the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang proposal. Others, notably Zhang (deceased) and Bernevig, Hughes and Fu, also contributed and the three-name limit is tight, but this triple gives a fair and clean configuration.
assessment.maturity: Mature: more than fifteen years of independent confirmations (HgTe, InAs/GaSb, Bi-Sb and Bi2Se3 by ARPES) and an established interpretation. Recognition is timely.
uncertainties: Weight to be given to the BHZ proposal and to Fu-Kane-Mele three-dimensional work versus the two-dimensional discovery.
Credit for the first three-dimensional materials and ARPES confirmations is spread over several groups outside the three names.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Localising gamma-ray bursts with BeppoSAX and detecting X-ray, optical and radio afterglows settled the long-standing question of their distance. They proved a cosmological origin and made GRBs a tool for transient astrophysics and the high-redshift universe. As an instrument-driven discovery it is very strong.
assessment.attribution: Costa and Frontera led the BeppoSAX Wide Field Cameras and gamma-ray burst monitor that produced rapid arcminute positions and the first X-ray afterglow. Kulkarni's group led the optical and radio follow-up and the redshift and energetics work. Van Paradijs (deceased) and Groot also contributed to the first optical counterpart, so credit is partly constrained by death. The supplied triple is defensible.
assessment.maturity: Mature after nearly thirty years of confirmations from Swift, Fermi and ground-based facilities; the physical picture is stable, although the progenitors are better understood now than the central engine.
uncertainties: Individual shares of the BeppoSAX instrument, the follow-up groups and the deceased contributor are hard to separate.
Whether the committee would prefer a broader gamma-ray burst framing that includes the compact-merger link.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The observation of a Higgs boson at the LHC completed the experimental verification of the electroweak mechanism and is one of the most consequential measurements in particle physics. The measurement of mass and couplings continues to constrain physics beyond the Standard Model.
assessment.attribution: The prize for the theory was given in 2013. The experimental discovery depended on thousands of collaborators, accelerator and detector builders, and analysis teams. Della Negra, Jenni and Virdee are plausible founding leaders of the proposals and construction, but any person-based credit is arbitrary and the Statutes make a collaboration prize difficult. This is the main weakness.
assessment.maturity: Fully mature and replicated by two independent experiments, with a decade of property measurements. Recognition is arguably overdue except for the attribution problem.
uncertainties: No unique decisive individuals exist; spokespersons and project leaders are not the same as discoverers.
Whether the committee could defend a three-person ATLAS and CMS configuration against other possible leaders.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The baryon acoustic peak provides a standard ruler imprinted by early-universe sound waves and measured in galaxy clustering. It underpins precision dark-energy and distance-scale constraints and is a clear observational discovery that links the CMB to large-scale structure.
assessment.attribution: Eisenstein and collaborators detected the peak in the SDSS luminous red galaxy sample, while Cole, Percival and the 2dFGRS team reported the independent detection in the same period. The two-collaboration configuration supports a fair shared recognition, though other SDSS and 2dF members also contributed substantially.
assessment.maturity: Mature and reproduced by many surveys (BOSS, eBOSS, WiggleZ, DESI), and a core part of the cosmological model. Timing is good, and tensions in recent dark-energy results are active but do not undermine the standard-ruler discovery.
uncertainties: Share of credit between theoretical predictions of the acoustic scale and the clustering detections.
Whether recent DESI-related tensions change the picture of the cosmological interpretation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: WMAP delivered full-sky maps and precision cosmological parameters that established the standard Lambda-CDM model with percent-level accuracy. This was a major instrument-driven advance after COBE and set the scientific case for later missions.
assessment.attribution: Bennett led the mission as principal investigator, Page led crucial instrument and calibration work, and Spergel led the cosmological analysis. This is a coherent split between instrument, mission and interpretation, though the large WMAP science team and the Planck successor complicate relative credit.
assessment.maturity: Mature and cross-checked by Planck and ground-based CMB experiments. Recognition could come at any time, but part of the achievement is shared with the COBE and Planck legacy, so urgency is lower.
uncertainties: Overlap in importance with COBE (2006 prize) and Planck results.
Whether the committee sees WMAP as a distinct discovery or a precision refinement.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The optical lattice clock, built on the magic-wavelength proposal, combines many atoms with Lamb-Dicke confinement to reach fractional uncertainties near 1e-18. It supports tests of fundamental constants, relativistic geodesy and a possible redefinition of the second.
assessment.attribution: Katori proposed the magic-wavelength lattice concept and demonstrated early clocks; Ye's group pushed the stability and accuracy to the leading levels. Ye already shared the 2005 prize for frequency-comb work, which does not exclude recognition but may affect the committee's view. Two names give a clean configuration.
assessment.maturity: Mature in the technology, with several independent laboratories reaching the 1e-18 regime; applications are still developing, and a redefinition of the second has not yet occurred.
uncertainties: Prior recognition of precision-spectroscopy and frequency-comb work.
Whether ion clocks (Wineland, 2012 prize) and other optical clocks overlap in the committee's mind.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The IceCube detection of a diffuse flux of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos, followed by identification of the blazar TXS 0506+056 and the Galactic plane, opened neutrino astronomy at PeV energies. It is a decades-long instrumentation effort in the style of earlier astroparticle discoveries.
assessment.attribution: Halzen is the conceptual and scientific driver of IceCube and the AMANDA precursor, but the discovery is the work of a large collaboration, and other leaders (such as the IceCube principal investigators and the detector builders) contributed decisively. A single credited name leaves attribution unresolved and is a limiting factor.
assessment.maturity: Reasonably mature: the diffuse flux is firmly established and cross-checked, while source identifications are fewer and the physical origin of most neutrinos remains uncertain. Recognition may be somewhat early.
uncertainties: The supplied credit is a single name and does not capture the collaboration and other technology leaders.
Stability of individual source associations as statistics grow.
My own field is close to this one, and I weigh it accordingly with a fairly critical eye.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background from pulsar-timing arrays opens a new band of gravitational-wave astronomy, probably from supermassive black-hole binaries, with implications for galaxy evolution and possibly new physics.
assessment.attribution: The result is a product of several independent timing-array collaborations (NANOGrav, EPTA, PPTA, CPTA, IPTA), and the three credited names represent different arrays, yet the decisive individual contributions are diffuse. Attribution is unresolved.
assessment.maturity: Premature: the Hellings-Downs correlation evidence is around the three to four sigma level, the origin of the signal is not established, and confirmation by further data releases is awaited.
uncertainties: Statistical significance of the correlation and the astrophysical versus cosmological origin.
How credit would be divided across four or five arrays.
